tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bod.name: Error report location tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bod.description: Checks that a bad request is reported as a problem with the request body or the web address, depending on what the request type actually reads.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Boo.name: First admin command tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Boo.description: Checks the command-line step that creates the first administrator, run as a real separate program.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Boo.name: First admin setup safety tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Boo.description: Checks that setting up the first administrator stays safe if the database connection drops or fails partway.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.name: Record dating change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.description: Checks the database change that fixes the order and dates of business records.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.name: Business record shape tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.description: Checks how business records are stored and that their stored shape stays as expected.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.name: Business record time tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Bus.description: Checks that business records get their created and changed times set correctly.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cat.name: Product catalog tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cat.description: Checks egg products, their grades, pack sizes, admin-only changes, starting products and the activity log.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.name: Email change race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.description: Checks that two people changing emails at once cannot end up with the same email or a lost update.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.name: Email change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.description: Checks changing a user's email, who may do it, and what is refused.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.name: Role change race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.description: Checks that simultaneous role changes cannot leave a farm without an owner.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.name: Role change tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cha.description: Checks promoting and demoting users, who is allowed to, and that the last owner cannot be demoted.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.name: Command-line routing tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.description: Checks that command-line words are sent to the right built-in command.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.name: Screen crash report tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.description: Checks that crashes in the screens are reported to the server and written to its log with useful details.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.name: Connected app lookup safety tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.description: Checks that the server's fetching of a connected app's description cannot be tricked into reaching private addresses.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.name: Connected app description tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cli.description: Checks which web addresses may name a connected app's description, and what the description must say.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.name: Sale flock access tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.description: Checks that confirming a sale reads a worker's flock assignments at the right moment, after the farm and order are locked.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.name: Sale confirmation all-or-nothing tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.description: Checks that confirming a sale saves the eggs taken, stock changes, order state and log entry together or not at all.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.name: Sale confirmation lock order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.description: Checks that access checks during a sale confirmation happen after the order is locked.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.name: Secure database connection tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Con.description: Checks that a live server refuses an insecure database connection unless it was explicitly allowed.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Sign-in pass version floor tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that a sign-in pass with an invalid version number is never accepted.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Two-step sign-in version floor tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks the same invalid-version refusal for the second sign-in step.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Fresh sign-in check tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that every request re-checks the database to see whether the person's sign-in is still valid.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Sign-in check position tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that the sign-in validity check runs at the right point in handling each request.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Sign-in check verdict tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that a request is let through only when the sign-in is confirmed current.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Sign-in invalidation race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that password changes and resets racing with sign-ins cannot leave an old sign-in working.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.name: Sign-in invalidation tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cre.description: Checks that changing a password or similar events cancels older sign-in passes.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cur.name: Currency lock race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cur.description: Checks that changing the farm currency while new records are being saved cannot mix two currencies.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cur.name: Currency lock approach tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cur.description: Checks why the farm settings update uses row locks rather than strict transaction mode to protect the currency.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cus.name: Customer and order tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Cus.description: Checks creating customers and orders and adding items to orders, with their rules and refusals.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dai.name: Daily egg entry correction tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dai.description: Checks that correcting or voiding a daily entry keeps its egg lots and bird counts consistent and never touches eggs already sold.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dai.name: Daily egg entry grade tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dai.description: Checks that a daily entry records sellable eggs by grade.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.name: Key certificate expiry tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.description: Checks what happens to the stored encryption keys when their certificate expires or is reissued.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.name: Encryption key re-wrap tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.description: Checks the command that re-encrypts every stored key under the current certificate.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.name: Shared encryption keys tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.description: Checks that every running copy of the server shares one set of encryption keys kept in the database.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.name: Old key certificate tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dat.description: Checks that keys from a previous certificate stay readable while listed, and only the current one encrypts new keys.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.name: Sample data author tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.description: Checks which owner signs the sample data, and that a disabled owner never does.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.name: Sample data cleanup tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.description: Checks that a sample data load that fails partway is cleaned up.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.name: Sample data tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dem.description: Checks that sample data loads once, does nothing the second time, and never loads automatically on startup.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Det.name: Farm record write safety tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Det.description: Checks that saving a record cannot be attached to the wrong farm.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.name: Disable user race tests
tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Dis.description: Checks that simultaneous disabling or role changes cannot remove the last owner or hurt the person disabling.
